Author: Nupur Bhati Bench: Nupur Bhati [2025:RJ-JD:22254]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 5426/2025 Kalyan Singh S/o Ram Singh, Aged About 45 Years, R/o Surawa Police Thana Sanchr District Jalore (Lodged In Central Jail,
Jodhpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sarvan Sainee For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sameer Pareek, PP  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 08/05/2025 1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.

2. The present bail application has been filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (B.N.S.S.), 2023 on behalf of the petitioner, who is in custody in connection with F.I.R.
No.62/2015 dated 20.03.2015, registered at Police Station Raniwara, District Jalore, for the offences under Sections 420, 406 120-B, 129 of IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the co- accused accused Bhanwar Singh and Ratan Singh have already been enlarged on bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in CRLMB No.9263/2024 and 7213/2018 vide orders dated 06.08.2024 and 03.08.2018.
He further submits that the case of the petitioner is not distinguishable from the co-accused and the offences are triable by Magistrate.

He further submits that the trial [2025:RJ-JD:22254] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-5426/2025]
of the case will take long time and no useful purpose would be served by keeping him behind the bars, therefore, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

Kalyan Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22254) on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126019442/
1 4.

entities.text: Kalyan Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22254)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application but is unable to refute the fact that similarly situated co-accused has been enlarged on bail and the offences are triable by Magistrate.

5. Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances of the case as available on record and looking to the fact that the the trial will consume time, thus, without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioner deserves to be released on bail.

6. Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (B.N.S.S.), 2023 is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Kalyan Singh S/o Ram Singh, arrested in relation to F.I.R. No.62/2015 dated 20.03.2015, registered at Police Station Raniwara, District Jalore, shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(DR. NUPUR BHATI),J 250-amit/-
